caption: The drawing shows a detailed depiction of a decorative metal object, possibly a component of horse tack such as a spur or bit. The left portion of the object is elaborately rendered in color, while the right portion remains as a faint pencil outline. The colored section features multiple circular disks, buttons, and intricate engravings in shades of silver, white, grey, and black, with floral and geometric patterns. A yellowish-brown twisted rope detail is present near the top, wrapping around a horizontal cylindrical bar. Above it, a large, oval, ivory-colored piece is situated, seemingly placed at an angle. There are rectangular and rounded metallic elements, as well as a patterned strap, all interconnected to form a unified structure. The unfinished right side mirrors the left in shape and form but lacks color and detailed patterning, appearing only as a lightly sketched outline. The artist's name, Harry Mann Waddell, is written near the lower right corner.
title: Spade Bit
